tools.name: list_public_products
tools.description: List fixed products that are currently public, active, available for sale, and orderable according to fresh DotMoose commerce data. When no fixed-family filter is supplied, the response also includes a curated directory for domains, Dedicated quotes, add-ons, licences, migrations, account features,

tools.name: recommend_product
tools.description: Recommend the smallest currently orderable public product set for a goal, or return the workload-specific Dedicated quote handoff when bare metal is explicitly requested. Fixed-product recommendations and optional backup/object-storage components come from live public availability, not a hard-coded

tools.name: list_current_promotions
tools.description: List only promotion codes explicitly curated for public MCP visibility and still active in current DotMoose commerce data. Product and billing-cycle filters are optional. First-party checkout revalidates final eligibility and stacking.

tools.name: plan_app_publication
tools.description: Analyze non-sensitive project characteristics and recommend the smallest current DotMoose product and publication workflow for a website, app, API, bot, MCP server/MCP App, SaaS project, or downloadable tool. This tool is read-only.

tools.name: quote_public_product
tools.description: Return a short-lived non-binding CAD quote sourced from current DotMoose sales data. Final tax and payment are completed in first-party checkout.

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check a normalized domain using the live DotMoose domain lookup path. This never returns WHOIS contact data.

tools.name: quote_domain
tools.description: Return current standard CAD TLD pricing for registration, transfer, or renewal. Premium-domain pricing is explicitly non-authoritative until first-party checkout recalculates it.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Create a short-lived signed product-selection intent and return a clients.dotmoose.com continuation URL. Account creation, required customer information, and checkout are completed on the first-party continuation page.
